fields: as a table: cols [stage, your step and who approves, documents issued], rows [[stage, step, documents]] (cells strings or {t, link}); stage cells "Name · clause" set the clause under the name; documents are split at ";". fold, fold_noun: on phones only (desktop shows the whole axis).
best_for: StageStacks draws what each project stage issues as the document file building up: the stages stand on one project axis, each stage's documents stacked above it as sheets of paper, its name, clause and who approves under the axis.

block.intro: Your proposal lists your system's subset.
rows: Specify and design · Annex 15, 3.3
Design qualification (DQ). Your quality unit approves DQ; your engineering lead, drawings.
URS compliance matrix; Basis of design; Risk assessment; P&IDs; Functional specification; Design review report; C&Q plan; Traceability matrix
Fabrication · Annex 15, 3.9
Installation qualification (IQ) evidence. Both parties sign the inspection plan; you verify records at IQ.
Fabrication and inspection plan; Material log and certificates; Welder qualifications; [PP joint records kept]; Pressure test and cleaning records
FAT and SAT · Annex 15, 3.6; GUI-0029, 8.1
Tests your quality unit agrees to reuse in IQ and OQ. It approves each protocol before execution.
Approved protocols; Executed protocols with raw data; Deviation log; FAT release decision; SAT report; Code review; Software version record
Qualification · Annex 15, 3.8–3.14
IQ, OQ and PQ. Your quality unit approves each protocol and report.
IQ and OQ protocols and reports; Dead leg register and slope survey; Sanitization records; PQ protocol, sampling plan, phase reports; Proposed alert and action levels
Handover
Your system owner accepts the package.
Document register and punch list; As-built drawings; Calibration certificates; Software backup; Operation and maintenance manual; Draft procedures; Spare parts list
Service and change · Annex 15, 4.1 and 11; GUI-0029, 7
Periodic review; changes go through your change control.
Signed service reports; Calibration certificates; Annual system review; Updated as-builts; Change-scoped test records
